King Halo: a young lady with a legendary 
mother in the Umamusume world, whose 
success is highly anticipated as one of 
the "Golden Generation."

She possessed the strong will to rise and 
try again as many times as it took to 
win... but her haughty words and actions 
kept dragging everyone around her along 
for the ride.

And so began our challenging days aiming 
for the Twinkle Series alongside that 
selfish young lady.
